subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should a structurally valid Skill Workshop replacement with no meaningful content continuity override `approvalPolicy: "auto"` and require explicit Gateway approval?
rationale: Both behaviors are internally consistent: unconditional automatic approval preserves the recently established workflow, while the exception reduces destructive-write risk. The permanent trust boundary cannot be inferred safely from tests alone.

options.title: Gate destructive replacements
options.body: Require explicit approval only when an update lacks meaningful continuity with the existing skill, while ordinary updates remain automatic.

options.title: Preserve unconditional auto
options.body: Reject malformed content but automatically apply every structurally valid proposal when the configured policy is automatic.

options.title: Gate every update
options.body: Require approval for all update proposals, trading workflow convenience for a simpler and stricter rule.

recommendation.title: Gate destructive replacements
recommendation.body: Require explicit approval only when an update lacks meaningful continuity with the existing skill, while ordinary updates remain automatic.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the automatic approval policy whose intended boundary this PR changes.
